🏴‍☠️ Pirate Adventure

Leave the flat, find the island, and bring three treasures home.

Play fills the screen. Escape brings you back here.

Pirate Adventure

You wake in a London flat. The gold belongs back there. Three treasures: the chest of pirate gold, the bag of jewels, and the pile of coins.

Start

Return leaves the title. R, when it is over, starts again and skips the title. HELP if you would rather not guess. SCORE tells you how many treasures you have secured.

Words

Same shape as Adventureland. Directions, GET, DROP, and a few extra verbs: READ, OPEN, SAY, CLIMB, BOARD, FILL.

East of the flat is the street, then the dock, a ship, a parrot, and a hold. South of the dock is the island. The book, the parrot, the anchor, the machete, the map, the bottle, and the key are how you get to the gold. The skeleton does not share, unless the parrot has heard the words.

Leave the London flat. The parrot knows the words, and the gold belongs back home. Return leaves the title. R, when it is over, starts again.
